notes.title: The Summer of Pride Steam Sale is here!
notes.content:
Calling all fabulous adventurers!

To us at Valiant Game Studio, it's important to underline that all love is valid and beautiful, and so are all genders and identities. Our own hero Brialynne used to be married to a woman, and you can decide while playing Pendula Swing what her dating habits should look like going forward. Does she cross race lines and date a goblin, or does she fall for the adventurous human lady?

To celebrate Pride, we're part of the first ever Summer of Pride Steam Sale!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36825300/5c105b2fa5e7ba39494de4adf001bea576ec7484.png

Check out great deals and discounts on a bunch of amazingly inclusive LGBTQIA+ games - including Pendula Swing, of course!

Summer of Pride 2020

notes.title: Spring Cleaning for our Summer Sales! Announcing discounts and improvements
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers!


We all contemplate a summer unlike any other, and it feels eerie that some things still go on as normal. Like the always much anticipated summer sales and offers, which hopefully will keep you safely entertained in this extra special year. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36825300/6cd7b85ec1262669e05309ad5746c5c33f550cba.png

We gladly inform you that Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey is part of the MIDBOSS / SUMMER OF PRIDE 2020.  The Summer of Pride is a month-long event of LGBTQIA+ streamers playing queer games, throughout the month of June. These fun “gaymers” will be playing some of the best and most unique games that showcase positive representation of queer characters and stories - like Pendula Swing, yay! 

To celebrate Summer of Pride 2020, there is an ongoing sale on queer-positive games, that will be available via the Chrono.gg storefront and on Steam from June 9-25. You can find Pendula Swing on both these storefronts with a discount of 40%. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36825300/579dfd2e23baefde9712513c259d177000233211.png

 There have been issues with item getting lost when you receive one with a full inventory. This should be fixed now. Please let us know if it still happens!
 The VIP guard at the Immigration Checkpoint used to have amnesia, and would not let you get into town a second time. We're happy to announce that she's now fully recovered, and should no longer insist on standing in your way.
 The issue with you not being able to finish the game if you left the area during the final part has been addressed and should be fixed. Again, let us know if anything is still bothering you about it!
 We've had issues with the dialogue with Jeff Wings - if you ask him about his brother, it could make you unable to ask him about the package that was delivered. While we respect his right to determine the topic of discussion, we've fixed some bugs with the dialogue and thereby hopefully made him a more cooperative goblin.
 We've had a report of a player being unable to give a permit to the goblin protester. While we weren't able to fully see why it happened, we've streamlined the dialogue a bit to hopefully fix it.

notes.title: Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey Patch 3.1.3 - your stories, published!
notes.content:
You wrote it, we published it! 

The literary artworks submitted by you, awesome adventurers, have now been published in Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey! Take a stroll in the Academic District and spend some relaxing time in the library. If you have any favorite story, let us know!

With this update, we also took the occasion to fix a few bugs reported by you - thank you So Much for your reports and help! Specifically, we looked into the conversation with Jeff Wings, whee some of you got stuck.  He will no longer refuse to talk to you if you start by inquiring about his brother. We also made sure that you cannot get stuck in the Immigration Checkpoint.

notes.title: How many pets can you actually have in Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey?
notes.content:
We had a cosy Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey launch this Sunday  - stay tuned for the video footage from our very long YouTube stream! For the very first time, we also broadcasted on Steam officially as devs and we were very happily surprised by the amount of adventurers interested in watching us play!

So, we decided to turn this into a habit. We will be broadcasting from the Valiant offices, every other week on Tuesday, between 4pm to 5pm our time (Stockholm, which is GMT+2; 4pm in Stockholm is 8am in San Francisco, but take that with a grain of salt because it is Laura here who's writing this, and I am a timezone disaster). 

Today we took the time to arrange our setup so next time we broadcast officially here, you will also be able to see and hear us. We have even made it so our official broadcasts appear officially on our official page! We do have hedgehog onesies that we use at the office and sometimes even when we are on stage, which we may be using....*

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36825300/30d7404f07f26b8256148faa2cdd288e2bb98d4b.jpg

The fact that we broadcast officially every other Tuesday doesn't mean that we won't be broadcasting unofficially at random other times. But what an official broadcast means to us is something with a theme. Next Tuesday, we will be gathering a lot of pets in Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey - and we will talk a lot about pets in general, both in game and real life. We might even show you pictures with our real life cats! 

What would YOU like us to broadcast and talk about?

See y'll next Tuesday!

Valiant Laura - timezone disaster extraordinaire

* the usage of hedgehog onesies cannot be guaranteed at this time

notes.title: Today's 42 is 3.1.1 - a patch with tiny fixes, thanks to your useful reports!
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers!

First and foremost, Thank You for being by our side this weekend, when our work for the past two years culminated in the launch of Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey! While it feels like we have done a much better job with bug squashing*, some of you still found some tiny issues that we fixed. The patch is 3.1.1. Here's what we fixed:


 some of you experienced crashes in the Harbour District - this was likely due to the Police being overly active with prohibition, probably because we stole their Chief's painting so many times; this should now be fixed 
 Jeff Wings occasionally lost himself in conversation, which prevented some of you to complete the main story line - he will pay more attention to you now, thus allowing you to move on
 Giglesh'Kern seems to be the sweetheart of Duberdon when it comes to dates, so we had a chat with him and taught him how to better shoot you gazes of love and ... well, he also decided to react if you still wear clothes when you're both in your bedroom. Right - This Is Also A Spoiler Alert 
 the invitation to your cousin's wake now also serves as an invitation to the city, so make sure you grab it when you leave home
 several characters have been... called to the principal's office and we taught them how to behave a little better
 we also fixed some typos, like the speakeasy' bartender's super sexy line "this is a test text"


We continue to keep an eye on your feedback! We are currently working in the Library to publish all the awesome content you sent to us, so we will be patching soon again!

*as always, no real bugs were squashed during the development of this game

notes.title: We will stream & broadcast the launch of Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey
notes.content:
Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey launch streaming
On Sunday, we will celebrate the International Women's Day at the office, launching Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey! We made a public event on Facebook where we begged anyone who would listen to have some Funny Jokes and pics with Cute Animals ready for us, because we will be quite anxious! Fingers crossed that everything will go well, and we are going to stream the launch on our YouTube channel and broadcast Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey here on Steam. Mark your calendars: Sunday March 8th, 3pm-6pm GMT+2. 

A glimpse for Sunday - our Valiant vlogs!
Did you know we vlog? We have 3 videos so far. We talk a lot about our hopes and dreams about Pendula Swing in the last one. We think it's a good glimpse of what you are about to watch on Sunday! Watch our Valiant Vlog #3 here:
[previewyoutube=ok2_Cdtkgt8;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope to see you on Sunday!

Anna & Laura

notes.title: Win a Pendula Swing: The Complete Journey key!
notes.content:
Freshly Printed - Read All About It!

The Goblins protests for their right to vote are on the rise! Police reports a worrisome increase in illegal Dwarven Ale trafficking, though when asked to show the confiscated barrels, the Police Chief shrugs and changes the subject. The Silver Gate Speakeasy keeps getting eviction and closure notices, but - let's be honest, everybody wants it open. 

Tired of the News? The Great Library in the Academic District is now open to public. Featuring an impressive display of bookshelves, it only lacks one thing: more books. Are you the author we are looking for?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36825300/795dd939c9aa22e4d57d346edcb45e5dd30317a1.gif

The Great Library wants to publish selected books about subjects relevant to Duberdon and the Pendulan society in general. They accept any literary work of quality, fictional or not, as long as it complies with the following rules:

 short title mandatory; no more than 5 words
 a maximum of 1220 character or about 205 words
 no profanities; except for [strike]describing Jack The Flyboy[/strike] .... nevermind
 polite, elegant language favoured


Submissions to be done on this community, as comments to this Important Announcement or under our Library - Are you the author we are looking for? thread. We may be lenient to those willing to start new discussions, especially if the story in question requires debate. 

The stories deemed most relevant to Duberdon and Pendula will be published and rewarded. One published story will be granted a special key that takes you to a magical land, all expenses paid. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36825300/006cda66d01ac751f03309c7bd979ae85dfe3d4b.png
